	play_song = "lr_super_world_war"

# The second world war: once three or more great powers are at war with another great power.
lr_check_world_war = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = LR_world_war } }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_majors_at_war = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_major = yes
				any_enemy_country = { is_major = yes }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { lr_majors_at_war = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { lr_majors_at_war > 2 } }
			set_global_flag = LR_world_war
			lr_super_world_war = yes
		}
	}
}
